name: node test mock timers date mocking setTime reset and apis filter
source: import { mock } from 'node:test'; function main(): void { const out: string[] = []; const log = (...a: any[]): void => { out.push(a.map((x: any): string => typeof x === 'string' ? x : JSON.stringify(x)).join(' ')); }; const realDate = Date; log('real', Date.now() > 1e12); mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['Date'], now: 1000 }); log('date only', Date.now(), new Date().getTime(), Date.UTC(2000, 0, 1), Date.parse('2000-01-01'), new Date(5).getTime(), typeof Date()); mock.timers.setTime(5000); log('setTime', Date.now()); mock.timers.reset(); log('reset', Date === realDate, Date.now() > 1e12); mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setTimeout'] }); log('timeout-only date real', Date.now() > 1e12); let fired = false; setImmediate((): void => { fired = true; }); mock.timers.tick(10); log('immediate not mocked', fired); mock.timers.reset(); mock.timers.enable({ now: new Date(7) }); log('now Date object', Date.now()); mock.timers.reset(); mock.timers.enable({ now: 5 }); mock.timers.setTime(); log('setTime default', Date.now()); mock.timers.tick(); log('tick default', Date.now()); mock.timers.tick(1.5); log('tick fraction', Date.now()); mock.timers.reset(); console.log(out.join('|')); }
